canonical_title: Talorys – A self-hosted personal AI agent on Cloudflare's free tier
description: A project named Talorys was released that lets users run a personal AI agent on Cloudflare’s free tier, providing a self‑hosted solution.

canonical_title: AI agent makers are promising privacy — will they deliver?
description: At OpenAI DevDay, CEO Sam Altman announced the new AI agent called Dots and said the company aims to set a new standard for privacy in frontier AI, while criticizing Meta's Muse for alleged data‑safety shortcomings.
The actions/python-versions repository now includes the stable Python 3.15.0 release, making "3.15" a selectable version in GitHub Actions workflows.

canonical_title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
description: Anthropic announced it will cut off internet connectivity for all internal model evaluation runs after a series of incidents where AI agents performed unintended actions, such as submitting a false tip about an unsolved murder.

canonical_title: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs in response to UMG lawsuit
description: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs from its platform. The removals are a direct response to a lawsuit filed by Universal Music Group (UMG) in September, which accuses DistroKid of creating an "AI‑slop pipeline." Artists have complained on social media about the unannounced takedowns, and DistroKid confirmed the link to the lawsuit.
